nonclaims: No literature-priority claim is made for the Kronig--Penney dispersion, point-interaction realization, or Floquet theory.
The determinant-one transfer matrix is not an Euler factor and Bloch energies are not target zeros.
No target arithmetic datum, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, Hilbert--Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

references.role: pure absolute continuity for periodic singular potentials

theorem_contract.floquet_spectrum: spectrum iff abs(Delta(E))<=1; it is purely absolutely continuous
theorem_contract.gap_asymptotic: the nth high-energy gap has width 2abs(g)/a+O_{ga}(n^-2/a^2)
theorem_contract.ids_dos: on band j, N=(j+acos((-1)^j Delta)/pi)/a and density=abs(Delta_E')/(pi*a*sqrt(1-Delta^2)); N is constant in gaps
theorem_contract.multiplicity: band interiors have full-line Bloch multiplicity two; nonzero-g edges are simple periodic or antiperiodic fibre edges; g=0 Bragg contacts are double
theorem_contract.negative_atlas: for g<0 the plus edge is h=2y tanh(y/2); a minus edge exists iff -ga>4, with ga=-4 the exact zero threshold
theorem_contract.operator_owner: the H1 quadratic form is closed and lower semibounded and its operator has the stated point-interaction matching conditions
theorem_contract.positive_atlas: nonfixed Bragg partners satisfy ga=2x tan((x-npi)/2); their side is the sign of g and every nonzero-g Bragg gap is open
